ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure with reaction arrows; ignore the arrows according to the question. On the left side is a benzene ring, and the benzene ring is connected to positively charged NH2, namely the protonated aniline group [NH2+]c1ccccc1. This nitrogen is connected to a central carbon; the central carbon is also connected to an ethoxy group OCC, and is connected to the upper C=C fragment. In the upper alkenyl region, the left side is connected to an ethyl ester carbonyl EtO2C, and the right alkene carbon is connected to a negatively charged oxygen [O-] and an ethoxy group OEt. Reasoning: According to the specified main chain, starting from the ethyl ester carbonyl it is written as CCOC(=O), connected to the C=C unit and retaining the alkene stereochemical marker in the figure as /C(=C(\[O-])OCC), then connected to the central carbon C(...). The two substituents of the central carbon are respectively the protonated aniline group [NH2+]c1ccccc1 and the ethoxy group OCC. Therefore the complete SMILES is CCOC(=O)/C(=C(\[O-])OCC)C([NH2+]c1ccccc1)OCC.

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中显示一个带反应箭头的过渡态结构；按题意忽略箭头。左侧是苯环，苯环连接到带正电的 NH2，即质子化苯胺基团 [NH2+]c1ccccc1。该氮连接到一个中心碳；中心碳还连接一个乙氧基 OCC，并连接到上方的 C=C 片段。上方烯基区域左侧连有乙酯羰基 EtO2C，右侧烯碳连有一个带负电的氧 [O-] 和一个乙氧基 OEt。推理：按照指定主链从乙酯羰基开始写作 CCOC(=O)，接到 C=C 单元并保留图中烯键立体标记为 /C(=C(\[O-])OCC)，再接中心碳 C(...)。中心碳的两个取代基分别是质子化苯胺基 [NH2+]c1ccccc1 和乙氧基 OCC。因此完整 SMILES 为 CCOC(=O)/C(=C(\[O-])OCC)C([NH2+]c1ccccc1)OCC。
